notes: Geometry is px in the 1080×1920 frame, origin top-left; center is [x, y]. Every sheet's short side is 300 px and, except the A3 in B10–B11, every sheet's bottom edge is at y 900.

Compositions center on x 540 and keep all ink, labels and every moving shape's whole sweep within x 140–940, y ≥ 240. check-render wants both the whole ink and the picture without edge labels within ±25 px of x 540 at each beat end, so pairs with a label on one side (B5–B8) sit a few px right of group-center, and the A3 label goes below its outline.
Draw order is declaration order across the episode (Mismatch beneath its two sheets). The loop depends on it: a4Ghost draws beneath a4Half at frame 0, and a3 beneath page at the end.

The loop: B11's last frame must equal B1's frame 0 (dashed ghosts, teal lower halves, names A4 and 레터, no notes). a3 ends as a4Ghost's box, page ends as a4Half's box with name 'A4', letterGhost2 and letterHalf2 copy sheet and half's frame-0 props. Every prop that draws pixels must match: stroke, dashed, fillOpacity, strokeWidth, names.
Comparisons match heights (standAndFit match 'height'), because B6 explains the fit that way: grow the folded half x times until the heights meet, then the widths must meet too.
√2 = 1.4142; Letter h/w = 11/8.5 = 1.2941. The ideal sheet (h/w = √2) also stands for the real A4 in B9–B10: 210 × 297 mm differs from it by under 0.1 px at this size.
Nothing shows a number until B4. The sweep shows only the gap.

Every exit is a 0.2 s fade; an appear sharing its anchor with exits waits for them. Handoffs between elements with identical boxes (page over sheet in B10) put the appear and the exit on different anchors, so there is no blink.

check-render will warn 'readable' at the end: the page's 'A4' and letterHalf2's '레터' are fully visible only for the last few frames. Expected: the loop continues them into frame 0, where both are visible.

Edge colors follow the role, not the physical edge: yellow is a sheet's long side (its height, since every compared sheet stands upright), blue its short side (width). So the original's short side is blue '1' while the same edge, as the folded half's height, is yellow '1'. The reasoning is height against height, width against width, which role colors show directly.

components.name: PaperRect
components.spec: Existing (studio/src/components/PaperRect.tsx; v1's spec). Changes: (1) standAndFit gains params match ('width', the default and v1's rule, or 'height': after the 90° clockwise turn, scale uniformly until its height equals ref's height, bottom-left corners together; a similar rectangle lands exactly on ref, any other one is narrower or wider) and follow (bool): once the action ends, the element keeps being the fitted half of ref's live box, i.e. ref's lower half (the long side halved) stood up and fitted by the same match, recomputed every frame, so it tracks ref's moveTo and resize. Later geometry actions on the element (moveTo) apply on top of that tracked box as usual: lerp from it, and once one has ended, its target is the box. (2) setStyle gains dashed (bool: the outline crossfades between dashed and solid) and page (bool: the document content below fades in or out). (3) New prop page (bool, default false): draws a plain document inside the box, laid out in fractions of the box so it scales with every geometry change while stroke widths stay fixed: title bar (filled rounded rect, color text, x 0.12–0.62 w, y 0.07–0.105 h); text lines as 4 px round-capped muted strokes at y 0.17, 0.22, 0.27, 0.32 h (x from 0.12 w, lengths 0.76, 0.72, 0.76, 0.46 w); a figure: muted 4 px rectangle x 0.12–0.60 w, y 0.40–0.66 h, holding a mountain polyline through (0.14, 0.64) (0.26, 0.50) (0.34, 0.58) (0.44, 0.47) (0.58, 0.64) and a sun circle centered (0.53 w, 0.46 h) with radius 0.03 w, both muted 4 px strokes, no fill; three more text lines at y 0.74, 0.80, 0.86 h (lengths 0.76, 0.70, 0.52 w). All points are (x, y) fractions of the box from its top-left. The title bar is fully opaque with 4 px corner radius. No text glyphs, so nothing to measure against the legibility floor. The content fades in with the element's content phase (appear) and is not drawn while the element folds; clear it with setStyle page false first. The first frame's folded halves need no change: each is a teal PaperRect over the lower half of a dashed ghost.

components.name: Note
components.spec: One line of text in the visual zone: plain text (Pretendard, type.label: 56 px, weight 600) with optional $…$ math segments rendered by Tex at type.mathInline, like Captions but not bold. Props: text; at [x, y] (the center of the line's ink box); color (theme name, default text) for the plain text; mathColor (default = color) for the math. No wrapping. Invisible until appear unless visibleAtStart. Actions: appear (fade in, ease.out), exit (the player's 0.2 s fade), setText {text} (old line fades out while the new one fades in; during the crossfade both share one left edge, which slides from the old line's left to the new line's (the new line is centered on at when done), so words the two lines share stay in place). Mark it data-text="label" for the probe, like other labels.

components.name: Mismatch
components.spec: As built (v1 spec): red symmetric difference of two live sheets, drawn beneath both.

components.name: Equation
components.spec: As built (v1 spec): one KaTeX row of addressable parts; reveal, transformTo with morph, box, exit.

components.name: Dimension
components.spec: As built (v1 spec): measurement line along a sheet's edge with a label beyond it; tracks the sheet.
